# G-Maiden

> G-Maiden is a Windows Dota 2 companion with a Rust/Tauri 2 core, React command deck, transparent overlay, local minimap vision, and voice advice. This repository also contains the landing/account services and the separate G-Orchestra developer tool.

Repository context index, version 0.2.0, reviewed 2026-09-12 against source commit a4a75542c857beaac68267b90e16707ad3263a45 plus the approved local GAP-01/02 remediation (application version 0.13.2). Paths are relative to this repository root. These files are local repository documentation; their presence does not publish an endpoint on the landing website. The extended reference records implementation evidence and known documentation drift; it is not a release certification or a new product specification.

Read AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md for contribution governance. Thai PRD/SRS and accepted ADRs describe intent; executable call sites describe implementation. Older feature maps and release statements need date and source checks. A source file, migration, or test fixture does not establish that a capability is deployed or verified in a live match.

Critical distinctions: Lite mode has no CV-driven gank detection; live GSI does not expose enemy economy; G-Motion is a heading-aware heuristic rather than a learned fog-path predictor. The release desktop has an entitlement gate; dev mode differs. Claude advice can send a constructed gameplay summary to a cloud backend, while G-Log files and CV images remain local in the inspected paths. G-Orchestra is a separate developer product, not the live warning engine.

## Desktop implementation

- [Rust application host](src-tauri/src/lib.rs): Startup, window lifecycle, 63 registered commands, entitlement, and update checks. main.rs is only a shim.
- [GSI HTTP server](src-tauri/src/gsi.rs): Five loopback routes, GameTick parsing, announcer dispatch, and watchdog.
- [Capture pipeline](src-tauri/src/capture.rs): DXGI orchestration, CV events, gank evaluation, and Lite fallback.
- [Motion heuristic](src-tauri/src/motion.rs): Five-minute last-seen history and heading-aware risk.
- [Signal state machine](src-tauri/src/signal.rs): Sensitivity thresholds, hysteresis, Alert, and Revision.
- [Advisor backends](src-tauri/src/master.rs): Claude CLI/API, explicit backend selection, constructed prompt, and throttling.
- [Local model fallback](src-tauri/src/slm.rs): Ollama model selection and historical default chain.
- [Speech and prewarm](src-tauri/src/tts.rs): Optional Piper, SAPI fallback, cached critical lines, and interruptions.
- [Voice-pack facade](src-tauri/src/voice_api/mod.rs): Split voice-pack implementation and archive/path validation.
- [Voice event schema](schemas/gmaiden-events.json): Vendored event contract; mirrored in voice_api/events.rs.
- [Desktop surface routing](src/src/App.tsx): Overlay versus control window and dev/release gate.
- [Command deck](src/src/CommandDeck.tsx): Navigation, page composition, and settings categories.
- [Live data composition](src/src/companion.ts): Tauri subscriptions and pure builders over honest fallback data.
- [Navigation and shortcuts](src/src/shortcuts.ts): Seven page identifiers and shared shortcut definitions.
- [Combat HUD](docs/design-system/07-combat-hud.md): Overlay design contract.
- [Sitemap and layout rules](docs/design-system/05-sitemap-ia.md): Bounded scrolling, pagination, and deck structure.

## Accounts, landing, and services

- [Desktop authentication](src/src/auth.ts): Google PKCE, OAuth transaction handling, and sign-out.
- [Desktop first-run gate](src/src/GmadFirstRunGate.tsx): Sign-in, Terms, eligibility, and setup surfaces.
- [Native entitlement decision](src-tauri/src/gmad_entitlement.rs): Server response validation and channel selection.
- [Runtime state](src-tauri/src/runtime.rs): Native entitlement latch and in-memory grace cache.
- [Account security UI](src/src/AccountSecurity.tsx): Session/device and security-event surface; not complete MFA/recovery.
- [Landing entrypoint](landing/src/main.tsx): Landing and public-demo pathname dispatch, analytics redaction.
- [Landing access contract](landing/src/gmadAccess.ts): Queue, Terms, and authorized download client.
- [Supabase local configuration](supabase/config.toml): Local services and explicit function JWT settings; not hosted-state proof.
- [IAM policy](supabase/functions/_shared/iam.ts): Capability and authentication decisions.
- [IAM runtime adapter](supabase/functions/_shared/iam_runtime.ts): Live-session queries, least-privilege DB access, and audit references.
- [Desktop entitlement function](supabase/functions/get-gmad-desktop-entitlement/index.ts): Backend eligibility decision.
- [Download issuer](supabase/functions/request-gmad-download/index.ts): Five-minute signed artifact URL after access checks.
- [CR-034 IAM scope](docs/change%20request/CR-034-gid-iam-production-completion.md): Phased IAM completion contract and approval boundaries.
- [CR-034 execution state](docs/operations/EXEC-PLAN-CR-034-iam-remediation.md): Dated reconciliation evidence and outstanding owner decisions; reverify before production work.
